The digit sum is \(8\), so it is not divisible by \(3\). Factor by grouping:
\[
101101101101 = 101 \cdot 1001001001
= 101 \cdot 1001 \cdot 1000001
\]
\[
= 101 \cdot (7\cdot 11\cdot 13) \cdot (101\cdot 9901)
= 101^2 \cdot 7 \cdot 11 \cdot 13 \cdot 9901.
\]
Since \(\sqrt{9901}<100\), checking primes up to \(97\) shows \(9901\) is prime. Therefore the largest prime factor is
\[
\boxed{9901}.
\]
